text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a cat or a tree. Another key task is object detection, which finds and locates multiple objects in an image at the same time. These technologies have many real-world applications. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to recognize pedestrians, other vehicles, and traffic signs. Hospitals also use it to examine medical images. As computers become faster and smarter, computer vision will continue to change our daily lives in useful and exciting ways.
